record.paper_title: THE LYAPIN’S NOTEBOOK: A COLLECTION OF UNSOLVED PROBLEMS IN SEMIGROUP THEORY
record.original_question: Determine whether, in the class of finite semigroups, isomorphism of power semigroups implies isomorphism of the original semigroups.

evidence.quote:
Problem 5.1. (E. M. Mogiljanskaja) Does the isomorphism of power semigroups implies the
isomorphism of the original semigroups in the class of finite semigroups?

          A systematic study of the properties of power semigroups began in 1967 with the paper
[7] by T. Tamura and J. Shafer. Among the results in this direction we mention an unexpected
theorem of by S.G. Bershadsky, (a student of prof. M. M. Lesohin, himself a student of Lyapin)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a semigroup $S$, let $\mathcal{P}(S)$ denote the power semigroup of $S$: namely, the semigroup whose underlying set is the collection of all nonempty subsets of $S$, with multiplication defined by
$$ A \cdot B = \{ ab : a \in A,\ b \in B \} $$
for all nonempty $A, B \subseteq S$.

Question: Let $S$ and $T$ be finite semigroups. If the power semigroups $\mathcal{P}(S)$ and $\mathcal{P}(T)$ are isomorphic, must $S$ and $T$ themselves be isomorphic?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent surveys and a 2024 arXiv paper on the isomorphism problem for power semigroups state that, although Mogiljanskaja settled the problem negatively for the class of all semigroups, the question remains open for finite semigroups, despite claims based on unproved announcements by Tamura. Positive results are known in several restricted classes (0-simple, completely simple, Clifford, cancellative commutative semigroups).

status_evidence.title: On the isomorphism problem for power semigroups
status_evidence.snippet: the problem is open for finite semigroups despite some authors having claimed the opposite based on results announced by Tamura but never proved
status_evidence.claim: The isomorphism problem for power semigroups remains open in the class of finite semigroups.

status_evidence.title: Semigroups of ideals and isomorphism problems
status_evidence.snippet: Isomorphism problems for ideal semigroups and power semigroups
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to study power semigroup isomorphism problems, treating the finite case as not settled.
